text:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 - spike in 5xx responses from /v1/infer in us-west-2. Error rate ~1.2k/min, customers seeing timeouts. Auto-retry may be amplifying. Paging @eng-oncall.

leo: acknowledging. pulling up recent deploys and traffic routing. oncall->leo (me).

maria: I'm on logs. seeing a lot of grpc: "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED" from runtime-proxy-3. KV cache eviction rates shot up ~15x. grabbing histograms.

anya: tagging product.incident channel for visibility. any customer-facing degradation yet?

leo: early signal from support: 3 customers reported elevated latencies, one saw request timeouts for ~4m. no outages in metrics for embeddings path yet.

samir: rolling back the small kernel-opt change from earlier today might help. it was deployed to the runtime pool in us-west-2 at 02:04 UTC.

maria: query I'm using to surface bad traces (Splunk):
```
index=prod logs "runtime-proxy" "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED" | timechart count by host span=1m
```
Found host runtime-proxy-3 with sustained errors starting 02:16.

leo: infra-bot, can you temporarily divert traffic for rerouting test? want to failover us-west-2->us-east for read-only traffic to reduce pressure.

infra-bot: executing traffic-shift. rolling 10% -> us-east immediate, can bump to 30% in 2m. will report back.

maria: trying a live mitigation: bumping kv cache size on runtime-proxy-3 and restarting. quick command:
```bash
kubectl -n runtime set env deploy/runtime-proxy RUNTIME_KV_CACHE_MB=512 --record
kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-proxy -l zone=us-west-2
```
I will run on the single affected node first.

anya: support update posted to #support: "We're investigating increased 5xx for inference endpoints in us-west. Fallback routing enabled. Will update in 15m." :hourglass_flowing_sand:

leo: infra-bot reports 10% shift completed, 30% started. error rate dipped ~20% after initial shift. good sign.

samir: still seeing bursts from a particular model shard (gpt-small-2024q3) — it might be a model-specific mem pressure + batching interaction. adding temporary shard isolation for that model.

maria: restarted runtime-proxy on runtime-proxy-3, kv cache increased. immediate error tail shows drop from 1.2k/min to ~700/min. continuing to monitor.

leo: ok, we have partial mitigation. plan: (1) keep traffic shifted to us-east 30% (2) disable kernel-opt rollout for us-west (rollback in progress) (3) tighten alert to reduce noisy pages while we stabilize.

anya: for customers: offering affected tenants a short post-incident note once we fully confirm. estimated customer-impact window: 02:16-02:28 UTC on us-west.

maria: proposing alert tuning: current alert fires at 100 5xx/min across region. it triggered lots for short bursts. suggest change to "sustained 5xx > 300/min for 5m" and add signature to exclude transient internal-retry amplification. also add a new dashboard panel that shows per-model 5xx rate.

leo: agree. Also add regex filter to the log-based alert to ignore known harmless probe errors from canary agents: regex: `(?:probe-agent)`.

samir: here's a suggested Splunk alert query tweak (one-liner):
```
index=prod "5xx" "/v1/infer" NOT message="*probe-agent*" | stats count AS errors BY region span=5m | where errors > 300
```
Will open PR for the alert change in monitoring repo.

infra-bot: rollback of kernel-opt rollout to earlier stable revision initiated (deploy/runtime-kernel set image to previous). ETA 2m.

leo: excellent. once rollback completes and we've held for 10m with errors < 150/min, we can start reverting traffic back.

maria: rollback finished. error rate now ~90/min across us-west and stabilizing. mean latency back to baseline.

anya: handing to second-shift oncall @samir for aftercare and post-incident items in 30m. @leo please create the incident ticket with timeline and customer impact.

leo: creating incident ticket: https://tickets.example/INC-2025-4021 (added logs, dashboard links, timeline). tagging postmortem owners: maria, samir.

samir: creating monitoring PR to: (1) change threshold to 300/5m (2) add probe-agent regex exclusion (3) add per-model 5xx dashboard panel. PR: https://git.example/mon/compare/alert-tweak-4021 (will link after CI).

maria: aftercare checklist:
- check kv-cache metrics and eviction rates in the next 24h
- run synthetic traffic to gpt-small-2024q3 in staging to reproduce batch mem behavior
- add unit test to runtime to avoid unbounded cache growth

leo: quick postmortem notes for follow-up meeting: probable cause = kernel-opt rollout + model shard mem pressure led to increased evictions and RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED errors, amplified by retry traffic. mitigation = rollback + traffic shift + cache bump. next steps = alert tuning + dashboard + canary gating for kernel opt.

anja: (typo) I mean anya — good work team. closing thread, moving to postmortem doc. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident auto-close check: will auto-close thread when last message > 60m of inactivity.

samir: I'll follow up in the postmortem with the PR and the regression test notes.

leo: leaving a final note: if anyone sees recurrence, re-open this thread or ping @eng-oncall. nice mitigation run.
